body.statement: For every \(\kappa>0\), honesty forces the zero-table interval at share \(s\) to have length at least \(\ell_0(s,\kappa)\), and \(D_{\mathrm{det}}(\kappa)\ge\sup_{s\in\mathcal S_T}\exp\{-\kappa m(s)\}\ell_0(s,\kappa)\). This follows from the exact constrained minimum \(\min_{\eta:\,\theta=q-1}M(\eta)=u(s)+qb_0(s)\) for \(q\in[1/2,3]\).
body.justification: The bound extends the exact zero-atom obstruction beyond the small-intensity phase without claiming sharpness where nonzero tables matter.
body.gap: Scalar exact-Poisson intervals exploit a single ordered count; no located bound maps the zero atom into a continuum of feasible causal ratio targets under staggered nuisance.
body.consumer: The bound gives every numerical certificate an analytic all-intensity lower benchmark and detects implausibly short candidate policies.
